title: Eel's Heavenly HUD
description: changes some hud textures to look heavenly
body:
This is a texture pack I made inspired by some stuff from Alex's Caves by Alexmodguy (https://modrinth.com/mod/alexs-caves) and also inspired by the Forlorn Hollows Inspired Hud by ImNinnn.
(https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/forlorn-hollows-hud)

The HP bar is meant to be heavenly shields | 
The Hunger bar is meant to be angel wings | 
The bubbles are meant to be bubbles | 
The Armor bar is meant to be heavenly chestplates |
